# Review title

## Scope and environment

State the feature/version, local/isolated/hosted environment, source files and date. State whether any real records were changed.

## Findings

| ID | Severity | Reproduction and expected behavior | Status | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Replace | Replace | Replace | Open/fixed/needs verification | Replace |

## Checks performed

Record exact commands, meaningful results and artifact paths. Distinguish observation tests from tests of the correct behavior.

## Limits and follow-up

State what was not verified. Link fixes and update [Known issues](../project/Known-Issues.md) without deleting the original findings.
